name: tanuki™ / PyFDEM
description: The first parallel, high-performance, pure-Python combined finite-discrete element (FDEM) code; showcased at ECCOMAS and USNCCM and used in the £10M ARIA Re-thickening Arctic Sea Ice project to simulate sea ice dynamics.

name: FEML
description: End-to-end differentiable framework coupling known PDE physics with machine-learned operators for missing-physics discovery, built on the Firedrake finite element system.

name: Fireshape
description: Developed industrially relevant shell and plate mechanics test cases for the open-source PDE-constrained shape optimisation toolbox, in collaboration with its lead developer.
